notes.title: Update 1.5.0
notes.content:
Added a first-person view
Visualization of the terraforming of the planet has been added
Minor improvements

notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.content: Now energy buildings such as a power plant and a water pump are connected automatically without connectors at close range when the building is in the placement mode. It is advisable to build energy buildings last.

notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.content: [p]Major Update: Added [b]creative[/b] mode. Minor innovations: [b]Crystals[/b] can now be made. I also worked out the behavior of enemies and other minor improvements.[/p]

notes.title: Updating the DEMO
notes.content: [list][*][p]Work has been done to localize the game, [/p][/*][*][p]Descriptions of buildings have been added, [/p][/*][*][p]The radius of the turrets has been changed[/p][/*][/list]
